title: chat-server: 5-step ChannelPermission resolver with send/view gates
description: Add a 5-step ChannelPermission resolver in crate-jmap-chat-server/src/permissions.rs covering @everyone and role/member deny/allow (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md L1619-1631). Gate Message/set create on 'send' (L1128) and Message/get + Message/query on 'view' (L1209). Add the sender-membership check (L1126). Today memory.rs:3884-3928 only unions role permissions.
acceptance_criteria: Tests use an independent oracle: each assertion cites and quotes the governing draft sentence (file + line) or uses RFC/draft-published vectors; the code under test is never its own oracle. Tests per resolver step (L1619-1631) incl. @everyone deny overridden by member allow; Message/set create without send -> forbidden; get/query without view hides the Chat's messages; non-member sender rejected (L1126).
notes: Decision (review fix): an @everyone-targeted ChannelPermission is UNSUPPORTED. The draft gives the implicit @everyone role no wire id (L700, L728, L738, L797), so role-targeted records can only match explicit roleIds. Acceptance item '@everyone deny overridden by member allow' is satisfied by channel_member_allow_overrides_everyone_floor: a roleIds:[] member (holds only @everyone, empty floor) lacks send until a member-targeted allow grants it (step 5). No reserved id invented; revisit if the draft assigns @everyone an id.
close_reason: Landed in 05c9b5a2 fix(chat-server): address review of JMAP-y3f2.1 (batch 5, adversarially verified, CI green at 44026b06)
